ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (26) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Благо» (blago) is 'the good' and «совершенствование» (sovershenstvovaniye) 'perfecting', so the closing «совершенство» (sovershenstvo) is 'perfection'; in the Epictetus passage «разумение» (razumeniye) is 'understanding' and «разум» (razum) 'reason'. Luke 9:62 is translated from the Russian wording («не благонадежен», ne blagonadyozhen, 'is not fit'), and the king's name «Чинг-Чанг» is kept as printed, 'Ching-Chang'.
